_comment: Hand-labelled Matching relevance of the 37 SYNTHETIC seed notices (data/seed_tenders/) for the FICTIONAL demo company (data/demo_company/profile.json: civil works, districts Kaski/Tanahun/Syangja/Parbat/Lamjung, class C, avg turnover ~5 crore). 'core' = the manifest's strong_match/good_match notices: the ones a good ranking must put on top. 'relevant' = core plus in-scope works whose notice is messy (an unknown deadline or cost) but which the company should still look at. Everything else should not be pursued: wrong line of business, outside the districts served, beyond capacity, a passed deadline, or a notice with nothing to bid on. Scored by api/scripts/score_matching.py at the fixed clock 'now' (seed deadlines are relative to it).
